title: Redis Flex: advertised flash-access latency
kind: Paraphrased observations from official Redis documentation
facts: Redis describes hot data in RAM as accessible in sub-millisecond time, and less active data in flash as accessible within milliseconds.
This is a product description, not a matched Lavik/Flex latency benchmark. The article interprets millisecond flash access as exceeding a sub-millisecond application latency budget.
